purpose: Verify main success flow of file creation where an employee creates and saves a draft file with mandatory comment and optional attachment.
preconditions: Employee is authenticated with an assigned role context authorized to create files.
action_or_input: Employee opens file creation, enters mandatory initial comment, adds an optional attachment, and saves as draft.
expected_result: File is persisted as a draft/pre-circulation file; audit record for creation, comment, and attachment is recorded.

purpose: Verify alternative flow where creator chooses immediate circulation to a recipient instead of retaining draft.
preconditions: Employee is authenticated and authorized to create files; valid recipient employee exists.
action_or_input: Employee enters initial mandatory comment and chooses immediate Send/Circulate to recipient.
expected_result: File is created and transitions directly into active/circulated workflow state held by recipient.

purpose: Verify alternative flow where file creation proceeds with comment only and no optional attachments.
preconditions: Employee is authenticated and authorized to create files.
action_or_input: Employee creates file with mandatory comment but omits attachments.
expected_result: File creation succeeds; file is persisted with comment and empty attachment list.

purpose: Verify exception flow where file creation is rejected when the initial mandatory comment is missing.
preconditions: Employee is authenticated and authorized to create files.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to save file with empty or missing comment.
expected_result: FTS rejects creation with validation error; no file record is persisted.

purpose: Verify exception flow where file creation is denied when the employee role lacks file-creation authorization.
preconditions: User is authenticated under a role not authorized to create files.
action_or_input: User attempts to invoke file creation.
expected_result: FTS denies the action with an authorization error.

purpose: Verify main success flow of draft editing where authorized employee updates comments/attachments and saves.
preconditions: A draft/pre-circulation file exists and employee is the authorized owner.
action_or_input: Employee opens draft, edits comment and adds an attachment, then saves.
expected_result: FTS persists updates; file remains in draft state; audit/version record reflects changes.

purpose: Verify alternative flow where employee chooses Discard instead of Save for a pre-circulation draft.
preconditions: A draft/pre-circulation file exists and employee is the authorized owner.
action_or_input: Employee opens draft and selects Discard.
expected_result: FTS removes the draft file; file is discarded and no longer exists in active files.

purpose: Verify exception flow where draft discard is blocked if the file has already been submitted and circulated.
preconditions: File has been submitted to another employee and entered active circulation.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to invoke draft discard on the circulated file.
expected_result: FTS denies draft discard; circulated file remains intact and active.

purpose: Verify exception flow where an unauthorized employee attempts to edit or discard another employee draft.
preconditions: Draft file owned by employee A; employee B is authenticated.
action_or_input: Employee B attempts to edit or discard employee A draft.
expected_result: FTS denies access/action with an authorization error.

purpose: Verify main success flow of sending/forwarding an active file with mandatory comment and optional attachment.
preconditions: File is active and not archived; sender is authorized current holder; valid recipient employee exists.
action_or_input: Sender selects recipient, enters mandatory movement comment, adds optional attachment, and confirms Send.
expected_result: File is forwarded; current holder is updated to recipient; movement, comment, and attachment are recorded chronologically; notification event is triggered.

purpose: Verify alternative flow where a recipient forwards a received file onward to another Institute Employee.
preconditions: File has been received by recipient B (current holder); valid employee C exists.
action_or_input: Recipient B forwards file onward to employee C with mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: File is forwarded onward; current holder is updated to employee C; movement is chronologically appended.

purpose: Verify alternative flow where forwarding proceeds without adding optional attachments.
preconditions: File is active and held by sender; valid recipient exists.
action_or_input: Sender forwards file with mandatory movement comment but without attachments.
expected_result: Forwarding succeeds; movement is recorded with comment and empty attachment list.

purpose: Verify exception flow where forwarding is blocked due to missing mandatory movement comment.
preconditions: File is active and held by sender; valid recipient exists.
action_or_input: Sender attempts to forward file without providing movement comment.
expected_result: Forwarding is blocked with validation error; file holder remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify exception flow where forwarding is blocked due to invalid or non-existent recipient.
preconditions: File is active and held by sender.
action_or_input: Sender attempts to forward file to non-existent or invalid recipient identifier.
expected_result: Forwarding is blocked with validation error; file holder remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify exception flow where forwarding is blocked if file is archived or user is unauthorized.
preconditions: File is in archived status, or user is not current holder.
action_or_input: Actor attempts to forward the file.
expected_result: Forwarding is denied; file state and holder remain unchanged.

purpose: Verify main success flow of returning a received file to the previous sender with mandatory comment.
preconditions: File is active; recipient is authorized current holder; previous sender is known from movement history.
action_or_input: Recipient opens file, enters mandatory movement comment, adds optional attachment, and confirms Return.
expected_result: File is returned to previous sender; holder is updated; return event is recorded chronologically; notification event is triggered.

purpose: Verify alternative flow where return proceeds without optional attachments.
preconditions: File is active and held by recipient; previous sender is known.
action_or_input: Recipient executes Return providing mandatory comment but no attachments.
expected_result: Return succeeds; file returns to previous sender; movement record contains comment and empty attachment list.

purpose: Verify exception flow where return is blocked due to missing mandatory movement comment.
preconditions: File is active and held by recipient.
action_or_input: Recipient attempts to return file with empty or missing comment.
expected_result: Return is blocked with validation error; file holder remains current recipient.

purpose: Verify exception flow where return is blocked if file is archived or actor is unauthorized.
preconditions: File is archived, or actor is not the current recipient/holder.
action_or_input: Actor attempts Return on the file.
expected_result: Return is denied; file state and holder remain unchanged.

purpose: Verify main success flow of viewing Inbox/Outbox and opening authorized files.
preconditions: Employee is authenticated in an FTS role context with received and sent files.
action_or_input: Employee opens Inbox and Outbox, and selects an authorized file to view.
expected_result: Inbox lists received files; Outbox lists sent files; selecting a file displays full content, comments, attachments, status, and permitted actions.

purpose: Verify alternative flow where an authorized archived file is opened in read-only state.
preconditions: Archived file associated with authenticated employee.
action_or_input: Employee opens the archived file.
expected_result: File is displayed in readable/read-only view; action controls for forward, return, and edit are absent.

purpose: Verify exception flow where an employee is denied access when attempting to view an unauthorized file.
preconditions: File exists with which employee has no authorized association.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to open the file.
expected_result: FTS denies access; file details are not disclosed.

purpose: Verify exception flow where an action is denied when not authorized for the current file state or role.
preconditions: Employee views file in Inbox where they are not authorized for a specific action (e.g. non-holder attempting forward).
action_or_input: Employee attempts the unauthorized action.
expected_result: FTS denies the action; file state remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify main success flow of viewing complete file tracking history.
preconditions: File exists with movement history; employee is authorized and associated with the file.
action_or_input: Employee requests tracking history for the file.
expected_result: FTS returns complete chronological movement history including sender, receiver, timestamp, comments, and attachments.

purpose: Verify alternative flow where tracking history includes creation, forward, return, and archival audit records.
preconditions: File has completed a full lifecycle including creation, forward, return, and archival.
action_or_input: Associated employee views tracking history.
expected_result: History displays all lifecycle events: creation, forwarding, return, and archival entries.

purpose: Verify exception flow where tracking history is denied to an unassociated or unauthorized employee.
preconditions: Employee has no association with the file.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to view file tracking history.
expected_result: FTS denies access; history information is withheld.

purpose: Verify main success flow of file archival by the file owner.
preconditions: File has been circulated; actor is the file owner; collaborative objective is complete.
action_or_input: Owner opens file and selects Archive.
expected_result: FTS transitions file to Archived/Read-only state; subsequent modifications and forwards are prevented; archival audit record and notification event are generated.

purpose: Verify alternative flow when archival is requested on an already archived file.
preconditions: File is already in archived status.
action_or_input: Owner selects Archive on the already archived file.
expected_result: FTS presents existing read-only state; no new archival state transition or duplicate notification occurs.

purpose: Verify exception flow where archival is denied when attempted by a non-owner.
preconditions: Circulated file; actor is a recipient/holder but NOT the file owner.
action_or_input: Non-owner attempts to archive the file.
expected_result: FTS denies archival request; file remains active in current state.

purpose: Verify exception flow where archival is denied when required authorization is absent.
preconditions: Unauthenticated user or user lacking required permissions.
action_or_input: User attempts to archive file.
expected_result: Archival is denied; file remains active and unchanged.

purpose: Verify main success flow of selecting and switching assigned role context for FTS operations.
preconditions: Employee is assigned multiple institutional roles.
action_or_input: Employee selects a different assigned role context in Fusion and performs FTS actions.
expected_result: FTS applies permissions of selected role; existing file ownership and past audit history are preserved.

purpose: Verify alternative flow where employee has only a single assigned role.
preconditions: Employee is assigned exactly one institutional role.
action_or_input: Employee accesses FTS without switching roles.
expected_result: FTS applies the single assigned role context directly.

purpose: Verify exception flow where a sensitive action is denied if the selected role context lacks permission.
preconditions: Employee switches to a role context that lacks permission for a sensitive action.
action_or_input: Employee attempts the restricted action.
expected_result: FTS denies the action based on active role permissions.

purpose: Verify main success flow of administrative access context management by System Admin.
preconditions: System Admin has administrative governance privileges.
action_or_input: System Admin assigns/reassigns an FTS role or reviews audit logs.
expected_result: FTS applies updated access context, triggers role assignment notification event, and maintains governance boundary.

purpose: Verify alternative flow where FTS consumes platform user account context without owning platform-wide directory administration.
preconditions: Platform administrator provisions a basic user account in Fusion directory.
action_or_input: FTS consumes the identity/account context for FTS operations.
expected_result: FTS recognizes the user identity for role assignment and file tracking without managing central directory.

purpose: Verify exception flow where System Admin is denied when attempting an operational file action.
preconditions: Authenticated System Admin.
action_or_input: System Admin attempts to create, forward, return, or archive an operational file.
expected_result: FTS blocks the operational action; operational processing is reserved for Institute Employees.

purpose: Verify main success flow where consuming Fusion module calls FTS workflow-support API.
preconditions: Authorized external Fusion module with valid credentials/context.
action_or_input: Consuming module calls FTS API for module-specific workflow support, approval chain, or request tracking.
expected_result: FTS validates authorization, performs requested tracking service, records audit event, and returns response.

purpose: Verify alternative flow where consuming module invokes different service capabilities (approval-chain vs request tracking).
preconditions: Authorized consuming module.
action_or_input: Consuming module calls FTS API specifically for approval-chain step routing and file-based request tracking.
expected_result: FTS executes tracking and routing services while preserving consuming module domain ownership.

purpose: Verify exception flow where unauthorized integration call to FTS API is rejected.
preconditions: Caller lacks valid authorization credentials or integration permissions.
action_or_input: Caller sends request to FTS integration API endpoint.
expected_result: FTS rejects request with HTTP 401/403 authorization error; no state is altered.

purpose: Verify exception flow where request asking FTS to enforce consuming module domain-specific approval policy is rejected.
preconditions: Consuming module requests FTS to evaluate or validate its domain-specific business rules.
action_or_input: Integration request submitted with domain-specific policy delegation.
expected_result: FTS does not define or execute external domain approval logic; request scope is bounded.
